acceptance_gate.condition: consolidated AUROC >= frozen CI low AND Exp 2837 rounded memory contribution >= +0.0185 AND Tier-2 SQLite state persisted
acceptance_gate.principle: Constraint-memory consolidation must not silently regress the FoVer discriminator or drop the FR-11 memory contribution.

field_principles.auroc_within_frozen_ci: BARE bool -- the consolidated AUROC stays within/above the frozen CI95 [0.9027, 0.9235]; the no-regression invariant.
field_principles.duration_s: Wall-clock plausibility floor; verifier-scoring + consolidation is modest.
field_principles.ensemble_auroc_under_consolidation: The ensemble AUROC after applying the consolidated deltas -- confirms the self-learning does not regress the banked discriminator.
field_principles.honest_verdict: Terminal prefix; the self-learning outcome; blocked_<resource> if a precondition failed.
field_principles.inference_substrate: verifier_ensemble_against_cached_candidates (principle: reads cached verifier scores, no live model).
field_principles.is_tier2_not_tier1: BARE bool, true -- confirms v18 is Tier-2 constraint-memory consolidation, NOT a re-run of v17's Tier-1 precision tracker.
field_principles.memory_contribution_preserved: BARE bool -- the +0.0185 fr11_session_memory contribution survives consolidation.
field_principles.model_specs: Names the corpus + 4 verifiers -- honest substrate.
field_principles.per_domain_threshold_deltas: The consolidated per-domain deltas -- the Tier-2 learned knowledge; the core deliverable.
field_principles.tier2_lookup_is_cpu_memory: Confirms the mechanic is a CPU + system-memory lookup (<1ms, the Tier-2 hardware path), not a model retrain.
field_principles.tracker_state_persisted: BARE bool, true -- the Tier-2 memory db was persisted so a future milestone resumes it.

inference_substrate: verifier_ensemble_against_cached_candidates (principle: reads cached verifier scores, no live model).

preconditions_checked.detail: online graph fit, graph learner, and fixed crossfit baseline importable
